name: Vegetable Ramen
steps: Slice mushrooms and carrot, cube tofu and mince ginger and garlic. Heat sesame oil and sauté aromatics for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and carrot; cook 4 minutes. Pour in stock and soy sauce, add tofu and simmer for 8 minutes.
Cook noodles separately in boiling water according to the packet; drain. Wilt spinach in the broth for 1 minute.
Turn off heat. Dissolve miso in a ladle of broth and stir back in. Divide noodles and broth among bowls; garnish with spring onions and sesame.
tips: Use vegetable-only stock and miso; add noodles just before serving so they do not soften excessively.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
